start: Diet plans on the owner login, gym online, no plans yet

steps.action: Open Diet plans
user_sees: Page "Diet plans" with "Send members what to eat" and the button "+ New plan"
"No diet plans yet" with "Start from a ready-made plan, like “Fat loss veg · 1,600 kcal”, change what you like, and send it to members or to everyone on a membership plan."
must_not: An endless loading state
Plans of another gym

steps.action: Tap "+ New plan"
user_sees: Sheet "New diet plan" with the groups "Veg" ("No eggs, meat or fish") and "Non-veg" ("With eggs, chicken or fish"), and "Start empty" ("Write every meal yourself")
"Each ready-made plan is for an adult of about 60 to 70 kg who trains 3 to 5 days a week. It uses everyday Indian food and is not medical advice."
must_not: Fewer than six ready-made plans
A ready-made plan with no doctor line

steps.action: Pick a ready-made plan
user_sees: The builder with "Plan name", "Goal (optional)", "Calories a day (optional)", "Protein a day (optional)", the meals each with "Meal", "Time (optional)" and "Food, one per line", and "Notes for the member (optional)"
The calories and protein boxes match the food listed
must_not: Meals in the wrong order
Boxes that do not grow, hiding typed food

steps.action: Tick members or a membership plan to send it to, then save
user_sees: Toast "“<title>” saved and sent." (with nobody ticked: "“<title>” saved. Tick members to send it.")
The plan under "Plans" with a line like "6 meals · 1,600 kcal · 90 g protein"
must_not: Two plans after a double tap
The plan sent to a member who was not ticked
"saved and sent" shown when the save failed

start: A member page, the "Diet plan" section (another way in: send to one member)

steps.action: Tap the send button in the "Diet plan" section
user_sees: Sheet "Send a diet plan to <name>" with "Your gym’s diet plans" (a plan the member already gets shows "Already sent") and "Or make one for them": "Start from a ready-made plan", "Write a new plan"
must_not: Withdrawn plans offered
A plan the member gets through their membership plan not marked "Already sent"

steps.action: Tap a plan
user_sees: Toast "“<title>” sent to <name>." and the plan listed in the section
must_not: Other members taken off the plan by this save
Another person edits of the same plan overwritten without a word

steps.action: Tap the stop button for that plan
user_sees: Toast "<name> no longer gets “<title>”."
must_not: The plan withdrawn for everyone
The member still seeing it in the app after opening the Gym tab

start: The diet plan builder, started with "Start empty"

steps.action: Save with the name empty
user_sees: "Give the plan a name, like “Fat loss veg”."
must_not: A plan saved with no name

steps.action: Type a name, leave every meal without food, save
user_sees: "Add the food for at least one meal (one food per line)."
must_not: An empty plan sent to members

steps.action: Type 500 in "Calories a day (optional)", then food under a meal with no meal name
user_sees: "Calories a day: a whole number from 800 to 6000, or leave it empty.", then "Each meal with food needs a name, like “Breakfast”."
must_not: A dangerous calorie figure sent to a member
Typed meals lost after the refusal

steps.action: Open Diet plans while the gym is not online
user_sees: "Diet plans need your gym online" with "Members’ phones read the plans from your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)."
must_not: A "+ New plan" button that cannot save

start: Diet plans, one plan that is sent to members

steps.action: Tap "Edit", change a meal, save
user_sees: Sheet "Edit diet plan", then toast "“<title>” updated."
must_not: A second plan made in place of the change
Members losing the plan after an edit

steps.action: Tap "Withdraw"
user_sees: "Withdraw this plan?" with "<title> will stop showing in members’ apps the next time they open the Gym tab. You can’t send this plan again; make a copy of it instead."
Buttons "Keep it" and "Withdraw"
must_not: A withdraw with no question first

steps.action: Tap "Withdraw"
user_sees: Toast "Plan withdrawn." and the plan under the line "Members no longer get these.", with only a copy button
must_not: The plan deleted from the list
Members still getting it

steps.action: Make a copy of the withdrawn plan
user_sees: The builder with the name "<title> (copy)" and nobody ticked
must_not: The copy already sent to the old members
An edit of the withdrawn plan accepted (the server says "This plan was withdrawn, so it can’t be changed. Make a copy of it instead.")

start: A plan sent to one member; what the member and others can see

steps.action: Read the note under the plans
user_sees: "Members see their plan in the MettleUp app (Gym → Diet plan) after they check in at the gym once."
must_not: A member who was not ticked, and is not on the ticked membership plan, seeing the plan
A member of another gym seeing it

steps.action: Look at the notes of a ready-made plan
user_sees: The line "Talk to a doctor if you have a health condition." and a line to show the plan to a doctor first for under 18, pregnancy, diabetes, high BP, kidney disease or a food allergy
must_not: A ready-made plan sent with no health line
The plan worded as medical advice

steps.action: Sign in as front desk staff and open Diet plans
user_sees: Staff who may send workout plans can open it; a login without that right gets the owner-only screen
must_not: A login with no right to plans changing what members eat
